# ComputeSubnetwork

`compute.gcp.hfl.dev/v1alpha1`

**Gap it fills.** Terraform's `google_compute_subnetwork`. A VPC subnetwork, with what the API takes only at insert: a BYOIP IPv6 prefix (ipCollection), the IPv6 prefixes, subnet mask resolution and resource manager tags.

**Source.** generated by `hack/discokind` from the compute.v1 Discovery document.

## Notes

Generated by `hack/discokind` from `hack/discokind/kinds.yaml` (`docs/design.md`
section 2.4); its test is `pkg/discokind/kindtest` with the fixtures under
`pkg/controller/direct/compute/discokindtest/testdata/discokind/ComputeSubnetwork/`.

A parallel kind for a resource Config Connector also manages (decision 19,
foundation item 16, 2026-11-23), for the fields the API takes only at
insert, which no field kind beside Config Connector's object can add:
`ipCollection`, `externalIpv6Prefix`, `internalIpv6Prefix`,
`resolveSubnetMask` and `params.resourceManagerTags` (input only: the API
never returns it, so it is not compared), and a secondary range's
`ipCollection` and `ipVersion`, in a list Terraform sends whole. Ours owns
the whole subnet; never use it beside Config Connector's object or
`ComputeSubnetworkFields` for the same subnet. To move a subnet, make ours
with the same `resourceID` (it acquires the subnet; the fields taken only
at insert cannot be added to a subnet that exists), then delete Config
Connector's object with `cnrm.cloud.google.com/deletion-policy: abandon`.

Immutable (CEL): what the API takes only at insert, plus `description`,
`network`, `purpose`, `reservedInternalRange`, and `ipCidrRange` and
`privateIpGoogleAccess`, which the API changes only by
`expandIpCidrRange` and `setPrivateIpGoogleAccess`; the generated
controller patches, so a subnet that needs either change stays on Config
Connector's kind. `enableFlowLogs` is left out (deprecated for
`logConfig.enable`).

The fake is mockgcp's own subnetworks (`kinds.yaml` `mockgcp`); its patch
changes only some fields (`docs/fake-cloud.md`), so the fixtures change a
secondary range and `allowSubnetCidrRoutesOverlap`. The `insertonly` case
makes a BYOIP, tagged subnet with subnet mask resolution on the fake and
skips live.

Live: pending. `task test-live PROJECT=$GCP_PROJECT KINDS=compute
LIVE_RUN=TestComputeSubnetwork`.
